name: AuntMan
source:
The story is about how families in a suburban town handle a worldwide incident that kills all adult men.
And explores the growth of young men in a mostly female dominated world.

[from [url=https://ismale07.itch.io/auntman-update]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了一个郊区小镇的家庭如何处理一场导致所有成年男性死亡的全球性事件。
并探讨了年轻男性在女性主导的世界中的成长。
